PagingWrapAsync<T>(IQueryable<T>, int, int, PagingCountMode, CancellationToken)

Wraps a queryable collection into a paged result with metadata, using asynchronous database operations.

public static Task<PagingWithQueryableList<T>> PagingWrapAsync<T>(this IQueryable<T> list, int pageIndex = 0, int pageSize = 30, PagingCountMode countMode = PagingCountMode.Normal, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

list IQueryable<T>

The source queryable collection.

pageIndex int

The page index (0-indexed). Defaults to 0.

pageSize int

The number of items per page. Defaults to 30.

countMode PagingCountMode

The count mode. Use SkipCount to avoid counting for large datasets.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

A cancellation token to observe while waiting for the task to complete.

Returns

Task<PagingWithQueryableList<T>>

A task that represents the asynchronous operation, containing a paged result with queryable list.

Type Parameters

T

The type of items in the queryable collection.

Exceptions

ArgumentNullException

Thrown when list is null.

PagingWrapWithEnumerableListAsync<T>(IQueryable<T>, int, int, PagingCountMode, CancellationToken)

Wraps a queryable collection into a paged result with an enumerable list, materializing the data asynchronously.
